# Air Astana Jobs

> > Central recruitment hub for Air Astana and FlyArystan, featuring pilot, cabin crew, engineering, and ground operations positions across Kazakhstan.

Air Astana's official job portal offers career opportunities in aviation with multilingual support (English, Russian, Kazakh). The site emphasizes pilot training programs, cabin crew recruitment, aircraft maintenance apprenticeships, and ground handling operations across major Kazakhstani cities including Almaty, Astana, Shymkent, and Aktau.

## Key Topics

- Pilot Recruitment
- Aviation Careers
- Air Astana
- Cabin Crew
- Aircraft Maintenance
- Engineering Roles
- Kazakhstan
- ATPL Certification
- Airbus
- FlyArystan
- Ground Operations
- Employee Benefits
- Ab-Initio Training
- ICAO Standards

## Core Job Categories

- [Vacancies](https://job.airastana.com/Home/Vacancies): Air Astana job vacancies listing across multiple specializations and locations
- [Pilots](https://job.airastana.com/pilots): Air Astana pilot recruitment and ab-initio training program page
- [Cabin Crew](https://job.airastana.com/cabincrew): Air Astana cabin crew job listings with qualifications and requirements
- [Engineering](https://job.airastana.com/engineering): Air Astana engineering roles including aircraft maintenance apprenticeships
- [Ground Operations](https://job.airastana.com/agents): Air Astana ground handling and airport operations department jobs
